dataset.name: SPRUCE S1 Bog Pretreatment Fungal Hyphae Carbon and Nitrogen Concentrations and Stable Isotope Composition from In-growth Cores, 2013-2014
description: This data set provides fungal hyphal carbon and nitrogen concentrations and stable isotopic composition data for samples obtained from the Marcell Experimental Forest S1 Bog in 2013-2014. Hyphae were collected using 40 um in-growth bags (10 cm x 10 cm) filled with sterile sand. Bags were incubated in the field in paired hummock and hollows at six locations in the bog at three depths and two topographic positions. In hummocks, bags were inserted at +10 to 0 cm above the adjacent hollow and in both locations from 0 to -10 cm and -10 to -20 cm below the hollow surface. All measurements were made at the SPRUCE Experiment site. The 8.1-ha S1 Bog is an ombrotrophic bog forest in northern Minnesota, 40 km north of Grand Rapids, in the USDA Forest Service Marcell Experimental Forest (MEF).

measurementTechnique:
To collect fungal hyphae, in-growth cores were constructed. Mesh (40 μm) in-growth bags (10 cm × 10 cm) were filled with sterile sand. Bags were incubated in the field in paired hummock and hollows at six locations in the bog. In hummocks, bags were inserted at +10 to 0 cm above the adjacent hollow and in both locations from 0 to -10 cm and -10 to -20 cm below the hollow surface. For additional details, see Hobbie et al., 2017.
After incubation, sand from in-growth bags was combined with ultrapure water and mixed at 80 rpm for 20 minutes. Suspended hyphae were removed with tweezers and the process was repeated until all hyphae were collected. Hyphal biomass was dried in the oven at 60ºC for 48 hours.
Hyphal samples were analyzed for %C, %N, δ13C, and δ15N at the University of New Hampshire Stable Isotope Laboratory using a Costech 4010 Elemental Analyzer coupled to a Thermo Delta Plus XP IRMS. Standard deviations of laboratory standards (tuna, NIST 1515, and NIST 1575a) for δ15N and δ13C averaged less than 0.2‰.
